_comment: Starter rules: every rule is in shadow mode (logs only). Run `claude-helper backtest` and `claude-helper events`, then set "mode": "enforce" on the ones you want, in ~/.claude-helper/guard_rules.json.

rules.message: Context is ~{value}k tokens (limit {gte}k): every turn re-reads it. A handover note was written to {handoff}: check it, add anything missing, then continue in a FRESH session.
Context is ~{value}k tokens (hard limit {gte}k). New agents and web calls are blocked: write the handover file and start a fresh session.
This session has used ~{value}M weighted units (limit {gte}M). Finish the current step, then hand off.
The same Bash command has now run {value} times. Stop retrying: read the error, change the approach, or ask the user.

This Agent call sets no `model`, so it inherits the parent model (often Opus). Re-issue it with an explicit model: haiku for search/log reading, sonnet for coding/docs/tests, opus only for architecture/security/hard bugs.
